lines.en: label beachmas3:
scene beachmasthree1
: Oh, good! You’re back. I was just about to stop what I was doing and chase after you for once again talking to my friends without inviting me along.
lines.zh: : 噢，太好了！你回来了。我正要放下手头的事去追你——你又一次背着我去跟我的朋友们聊天，还不叫上我。

lines.en: : We were just having another...emergency meeting to plan your next birthday party.
lines.zh: : 我们刚才在开又一场……紧急会议，规划你的下一个生日派对。

lines.en: scene beachmasthree2
: Wow...you guys are really getting the ball rolling early this time, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 哇……你们这次可真是提前很久就开始张罗了，是吧？

lines.en: Ayane and I make our way back to the rest of the girls while Maya ventures off to do...Maya stuff.
lines.zh: Ayane 和我回到其他女孩那边，而 Maya 则跑去干……Maya 的事了。

lines.en: But considering the fact that none of them greeted either of us with concern or confusion tells me that, in our recent “absence,” things have stayed at least somewhat normal.
lines.zh: 但没有一个人带着担心或困惑跟我们打招呼，这说明在我们最近这次「缺席」期间，事情至少还算正常。

lines.en: And that is something I can say with confidence given just how many “Sensei, are you okay?”s I have gotten succeeding my {i}blackouts{/i} over the past couple years.
lines.zh: 这一点我可以很有把握地说——毕竟过去几年里，我{i}昏迷{/i}醒来后听到过太多次「Sensei，你还好吗」。

lines.en: But now comes that hard part — figuring out exactly how much we missed and what may have happened within that time.
lines.zh: 但现在到了难办的部分——搞清楚我们到底错过了多少，以及在那段时间里可能发生了什么。

lines.en: : So, Halloween. Am I right?
lines.zh: : 那么，万圣节。我说得对吧？

lines.en: Okay. Or Ayane’s just going to get right to work with the completely normal and not at all suspicious beach conversation topic of a holiday that may or may not have just happened.
lines.zh: 好吧。或者说 Ayane 打算直接进入正题，挑了个完全正常、一点也不可疑的海滩话题——一个可能发生了也可能没发生过的节日。

lines.en: : No, I don’t believe you are.
lines.zh: : 不，我不觉得你对。

lines.en: : First my birthday, now Halloween? Why are you acting like you’ve gone back in time all of a sudden?
lines.zh: : 先是我的生日，现在又是万圣节？你怎么突然表现得像是回到过去了？

lines.en: : If this is another inside joke you guys have thought up while I wasn’t around, I’m-
lines.zh: : 如果这又是你们趁我不在想出来的什么内部梗，那我——

lines.en: : Oh, no. Just...thought I’d break the ice.
lines.zh: : 噢，不是。只是……想破个冰。

lines.en: : Maybe break the ice with something a little more relevant and {i}natural{/i} next time.
lines.zh: : 下次也许可以用更贴切、更{i}自然{/i}一点的东西破冰。

lines.en: scene beachmasthree3
: My bad! Just...can’t wait for whatever the next holiday is! Which could really be {i}anything{/i} with how many lesser-known, weirdly specific holidays there are nowadays.
lines.zh: : 我的错！只是……等不及想知道下一个节日是什么了！考虑到现在有那么多冷门又具体得离谱的节日，那真可能是{i}任何一个{/i}。

lines.en: : Have you been microwaving any bananas lately? Are there secret government agencies on your trail? Because I can help you. I just need to know {i}how.{/i}
lines.zh: : 你最近有把香蕉放进微波炉吗？有秘密政府机构在跟踪你吗？因为我可以帮你。我只需要知道是{i}哪种{/i}。

lines.en: : At least you’re acting normal, Sensei. Sudden and suspicious disappearances become a lot {i}more{/i} suspicious when {i}both{/i} people who disappeared are suddenly acting...you know. Suspicious.
lines.zh: : 至少你表现得还算正常，Sensei。突然又可疑的失踪，在{i}两个{/i}失踪的人都突然表现得……你知道的，可疑的时候，就变得{i}更加{/i}可疑了。

lines.en: : Didn’t...um...
: Wasn’t...Maya...with you as well?
lines.zh: : Maya……不是也跟你在一起吗？

lines.en: : Hey, yeah. Where’d Maya go? They just opened some new stalls further down the beach and we were supposed to go buy some stuff for tonight.
lines.zh: : 对啊，Maya 去哪儿了？海滩再往前开了几个新摊子，我们说好要去买点今晚用的东西。

lines.en: : Beats me. She’s probably off preparing for the date we’re going on later.
lines.zh: : 谁知道。她大概是去为我们待会儿的约会做准备了。

lines.en: scene beachmasthree4
: Pardon me for asking, Sir- but did you perhaps finish the rest of our routes and then proceed to erase our recollection of them? Because I always assumed the Maya route would be the last to unlock.
lines.zh: : 恕我冒昧，先生——您是不是已经把我们的其余线路都通关了，然后抹掉了我们对那些线路的记忆？因为我一直以为 Maya 线会是最后才解锁的。

lines.en: : There will be no Maya route. Or a Molly route. Or a Sana route or an Ayane route. Or any route other than an Ami route.
lines.zh: : 不会有什么 Maya 线。也不会有 Molly 线、Sana 线或者 Ayane 线。除了 Ami 线，任何线路都不会有。

lines.en: : I am the only heroine Sensei needs and he is smart enough to never choose anyone else. Isn’t that right, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 我是 Sensei 唯一需要的女主角，而他聪明得很，永远不会选别人。对吧，Sensei？

lines.en: menu:
I pledge to only play the Ami route
lines.zh: 我发誓只玩 Ami 线

lines.en: : Sure.
lines.zh: : 当然。

lines.en: scene beachmasthree5
: See? I’m the only one good enough for him and that’s how things will always be forever and ever and ever and-
lines.zh: : 看吧？我是唯一配得上他的人，事情永远永远永远都会是这样——

lines.en: : I suppose there are worse choices to be made. I’m no stranger to gunning it for the incest route if the heroine is likable. And Ami seems like good heroine material at the end of the day.
lines.zh: : 我想，比这更糟的选择也有的是。只要女主角讨人喜欢，我倒也不介意冲一把骨科线。话说到底，Ami 看起来是块当女主角的好材料。

lines.en: : Uh...how about we...don’t talk about...weird things like that?
lines.zh: : 呃……我们要不……别聊……这种奇怪的东西？

lines.en: : Is it really {i}weird,{/i} though? Because I don’t see how it’s any different from a more standard kind of-
lines.zh: : 可这真的很{i}奇怪{/i}吗？因为我看不出它和那种更标准的有什么不同——

lines.en: : Ami, stop it.
lines.zh: : Ami，别说了。

lines.en: if amifingered == True:

: As interested in hearing about your undying love for me as I {i}always{/i} am, I find it hard to carry on with this conversation while Ayane looks so...melancholically resigned and mildly complacent.
lines.zh: : 虽然我{i}向来{/i}乐于听你诉说对我至死不渝的爱，但在 Ayane 看起来那么……忧郁地认命、又带着点逆来顺受的时候，我实在很难继续这场对话。

lines.en: else:
: People are going to start saying things.
lines.zh: : 别人会说闲话的。

lines.en: : Oh no. Whatever would we do if that were to happen?
lines.zh: : 噢不。要是真那样，我们可怎么办才好？

lines.en: scene beachmasthree6
: G...Getting things back on track, would anyone happen to remember what day it is?
lines.zh: : 那……那说回正题，有人碰巧记得今天是什么日子吗？

lines.en: : What track are you even on exactly? Because your entire appearance today has made it sound like you’re playing Crash Team Racing while the rest of us are cruising down Rainbow Road.
lines.zh: : 你说的「正题」到底是在哪条轨道上啊？因为你今天一整天的表现听起来都像是在玩《古惑狼赛车》，而我们其他人都在彩虹之路上兜风。

lines.en: : Hm? It’s Monday.
lines.zh: : 嗯？是星期一。

lines.en: : If it’s Monday...why aren’t we in school?
lines.zh: : 既然是星期一……我们为什么不在学校？

lines.en: : What part of this is {i}natural{/i} to you?
lines.zh: : 这有什么地方让你觉得{i}正常{/i}的？

lines.en: scene beachmasthree7
: I’ve got it! You {i}have{/i} completed Ayane’s route!
lines.zh: : 我知道了！你{i}通关了{/i} Ayane 的路线！

lines.en: : And the only reason she’s acting so strangely today is because her memories are slowly leaking back into her due to the sheer power of her love for you!
lines.zh: : 而她今天表现得这么奇怪，唯一的解释就是——由于她对你的爱拥有压倒性的力量，她的记忆正在慢慢渗回来！

lines.en: : There’s no need to tell me I’m right. I already know I am.
lines.zh: : 不用告诉我我是对的。我已经知道我是对的。

lines.en: : You’re not. But strangely enough, I’m not really 100%% confident in saying that.
lines.zh: : 你不是。但奇怪的是，我说这话时也不是百分百有把握。

lines.en: : Uhh...we’re not in school because we’re on Winter break, obviously.
lines.zh: : 呃……我们不在学校，是因为我们在放寒假，很明显啊。

lines.en: scene beachmasthree8
: How is that obvious?! We’re at the beach and it’s gotta be like...ninety-five degrees!
lines.zh: : 这哪里明显了？！我们在海滩上，而且气温得有……九十五度！

lines.en: : Why are you using Fahrenheit? We live in Japan.
lines.zh: : 你为什么用华氏度？我们住在日本。

lines.en: : It’s obvious because the calendar says it’s winter, so it’s obviously winter. I don’t see why you have to be so weird about it.
lines.zh: : 明显是因为日历上写着冬天，所以显然就是冬天。我不明白你为什么非要在这件事上这么奇怪。

lines.en: : Plus, even if it {i}wasn’t{/i} winter, we’d still have off for Christmas tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 再说，就算{i}不是{/i}冬天，明天圣诞节我们也一样放假。

lines.en: scene beachmasthree9
: C...Christmas is tomorrow?!
lines.zh: : 圣……圣诞节是明天？！

lines.en: : I guess I’ll be the one to just slip in the fact that Christmas is always in winter and that what Ami said just now didn’t really make any sense.
lines.zh: : 那我就顺嘴说一句吧——圣诞节本来就在冬天，而 Ami 刚才说的那句话其实完全说不通。

lines.en: : Should we maybe take the bubble wrap princess back to the inn? I’m worried that she may hurt herself in her confusion.
lines.zh: : 我们要不要把这位气泡纸公主送回旅馆？我怕她在困惑中伤到自己。

lines.en: : I...can go back with you if you want...
lines.zh: : 我……可以跟你们一起回去，如果你想的话……

lines.en: : I’m...kind of...hot out here anyway...
lines.zh: : 反正我在外面也……有点……热……

lines.en: : You certainly are in that swimsuit. I mean what? I didn’t say anything.
lines.zh: : 你穿着那件泳装确实热。我是说——什么？我什么都没说。

lines.en: : And I...didn’t {i}hear{/i} anything...
lines.zh: : 而我也……什么都没{i}听见{/i}……

lines.en: scene beachmasthree10

: No...I’m...I’m good. I just didn’t really sleep that well, I guess. So sorry if I wind up periodically saying more suspicious-sounding things throughout the day. Which is...apparently Christmas Eve.
lines.zh: : 不……我……我没事。只是没怎么睡好，大概。所以如果我今天时不时说出些听起来更可疑的话，先说声抱歉。而今天……显然是平安夜。

lines.en: : Really? We slept in the same bed and I don't remember you waking up even once. But, then again, it wouldn’t be the first time you snuck out of bed without me realizing it.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？我们睡在同一张床上，我都不记得你醒过哪怕一次。不过话说回来，你趁我没察觉溜下床，这也不是第一次了。

lines.en: scene beachmasthree11
: Uhh...one last question. If tomorrow is Christmas, how come we’re at the beach {i}now?{/i}
lines.zh: : 呃……最后一个问题。如果明天是圣诞节，那我们{i}现在{/i}为什么在海滩上？

lines.en: : Don’t we normally hang out at that hotel in the urban district for Christmas? And...don’t we normally come to the beach {i}before{/i} Halloween?
lines.zh: : 圣诞节我们不是一般在市区那家酒店过吗？而且……我们不是一般在万圣节{i}之前{/i}来海滩吗？

lines.en: : Do we? I don’t know. Things seemed pretty normal to me.
lines.zh: : 是吗？我不知道。在我看来一切都很正常。

lines.en: : The only complaint I have is that we still don’t know what the grand prize from the Dorm Wars is apart from the fact that it’s just Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我唯一的抱怨是，我们还是不知道宿舍战争的大奖是什么——只知道那是 Sensei 本人。

lines.en: : Am I not just rooming with the winning floor again?
lines.zh: : 我不是又要去跟获胜楼层住一起吗？

lines.en: scene beachmasthree12
: No. Imani didn’t like that idea and she said you should just stay with her instead.
lines.zh: : 不。Imani 不喜欢这个主意，她说你应该跟她住。

lines.en: : Okay. And where is Imani being forced to sleep after you all joined hands and rejected that suggestion together?
lines.zh: : 好啊。那在你们手拉手一起否决了那个建议之后，Imani 被逼着睡哪儿？

lines.en: : Our room. Tied up in the corner.
lines.zh: : 我们房间。捆在角落里。

lines.en: : Oh well. Safer your room than the one Kirin is in, I guess.
lines.zh: : 噢好吧。你房间总比 Kirin 那间安全，我想。

lines.en: : How does that affect the Christmas party, though? If we’re still having one, that is.
lines.zh: : 可这跟圣诞派对有什么关系？如果我们还要办的话。

lines.en: : I told you earlier, didn’t I? That’s going to be in our room as well. All the fun stuff is happening in the first floor's room since it’s bigger.
lines.zh: : 我不是早说过了吗？也在我们房间办。所有好玩的事都在一楼的房间里进行，因为那里比较大。

lines.en: : And also because we’re the superior floor that loves you more.
lines.zh: : 还因为我们是更优秀的楼层，更爱你。

lines.en: if dormwar2floor2win == True:
: And yet...{i}my{/i} floor is the one that emerged victorious. How strange.
lines.zh: : 然而……获胜的却是{i}我们{/i}楼层。真奇怪。

lines.en: : Are you suggesting something, Molly?
lines.zh: : 你是在暗示什么吗，Molly？

lines.en: : Oh, no. No...
lines.zh: : 噢，不。没有……

lines.en: : Just the fact that our floor will undoubtedly have the better h-scenes due to our more extreme personalities.
lines.zh: : 只是我们楼层无疑会有更棒的 H 场景，因为我们的个性更极端。

lines.en: : {size=-15}Well, you’ll certainly have {i}more{/i} of them at this rate.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-15}嗯，照这个势头，你们的戏份肯定会{i}更多{/i}。{/size}

lines.en: Well...I guess that solves the “{i}Where are we in time?{/i}” question.
lines.zh: 好吧……我想「{i}我们处在时间轴的哪里{/i}」这个问题算是解决了。

lines.en: But if nearly a full two months have passed since the ending of the Dorm Wars...just what {i}else{/i} has happened within that time?
lines.zh: 但如果距离宿舍战争结束已经过去了将近整整两个月……那段时间里还发生了{i}些什么{/i}？

lines.en: And, better question, what happened between {i}Yumi{/i} and me? Because I was talking to her when the sudden transition came and...
lines.zh: 而更好的问题是，我和 {i}Yumi{/i} 之间发生了什么？因为突然转换发生时我正在跟她说话，然后……

lines.en: And if the way she looked is any indicator of how that must have gone from her perspective, there’s no doubt she’d be confused.
lines.zh: 而如果她当时的神情能说明她视角下的那段经历是怎么过去的，那她无疑会很困惑。

lines.en: I should...probably go and find her.
lines.zh: 我大概……该去找她了。

lines.en: : Uhh...have any of you seen Yumi, by any chance?
lines.zh: : 呃……你们有谁碰巧见过 Yumi 吗？

lines.en: scene beachmasthree13
: Was being with her all morning not enough?
lines.zh: : 跟她待了一上午还不够吗？

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : I believe Arborea is referring to the mass amount of affection points you have been grinding with her lately.
lines.zh: : 我相信 Arborea 指的是你最近一直在疯狂刷她的好感度。

lines.en: : It’s true that you...have been spending more time with her than normal lately...
lines.zh: : 你最近……确实比平时花更多时间跟她在一起……

lines.en: Ayane and I exchange a glance of mutual confusion as to what this must mean, but it doesn’t detract from the fact that I need to see her {i}now{/i} to clear all of that up.
lines.zh: Ayane 和我交换了一个共同困惑的眼神，不明白这意味着什么，但这并不影响我{i}现在{/i}需要去见她、把一切说清楚。

lines.en: : No one’s seen her since you scared her off a little while ago. And I wouldn’t bother chasing after her if I were you.
lines.zh: : 从你刚才把她吓跑之后，就没人见过她。如果我是你，我也不会去追她。

lines.en: : Well, you’re {i}not{/i} me. And I’m free to chase whoever I want to chase after.
lines.zh: : 可你{i}不是{/i}我。我想追谁就追谁。

lines.en: scene beachmasthree14
: Hey, don’t be mean! I’m only saying that because you’ve seemed really exhausted lately and I worry about you.
lines.zh: : 嘿，别这么凶！我这么说只是因为你最近看起来真的很疲惫，我很担心你。

lines.en: : I know it’s {i}my{/i} job to take care of you, but if you don’t start taking {i}some{/i} sort of care of yourself,  you’ll wind up-
lines.zh: : 我知道照顾你是{i}我{/i}的职责，但如果你再不好好照顾{i}自己{/i}一点，你会落得——

lines.en: : Yeah...I know. I just-
lines.zh: : 嗯……我知道。我只是——

lines.en: : I’ll see you guys later on...
lines.zh: : 回头见……

lines.en: scene black
scene beachmasthree15
: Yasu, please be careful. You know I don’t like it when you go in the water without your floaties.
lines.zh: : Yasu，请小心。你知道我不喜欢你不套游泳圈就下水。

lines.en: : It was hard enough getting you to stop nearly drowning yourself in the bathtub and the last thing I want to spend this holiday season doing is planning a funeral for a body lost at sea.
lines.zh: : 光是让你别在浴缸里差点把自己淹死就已经够难了，而这个假期我最不想做的事，就是为一位葬身大海的人筹划葬礼。

lines.en: : Hey, let’s not bring up funerals.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我们别提葬礼了。

lines.en: scene beachmasthree16
: Oh my! I’m so terribly sorry, Makoto. It simply slipped my mind and I will do my best to make sure it doesn’t happen again.
lines.zh: : 噢天哪！我实在万分抱歉，Makoto。我一时疏忽了，我会尽力确保不再发生。

lines.en: : It’s whatever.
lines.zh: : 无所谓。

lines.en: : Dwelling on it won’t help me move on at all but, at the same time, hearing anything that {i}reminds{/i} me of it just makes me feel like shit again.
lines.zh: : 沉溺其中并不能帮我走出来，但同时，任何让我{i}想起{/i}那件事的东西都会让我又难受起来。

lines.en: : How fun and exciting it is to have a never-ending connection to misery that I can, in no way, learn how to subvert or move past. Yippee.
lines.zh: : 与痛苦建立起一种永无止境的联系，却完全学不会如何摆脱它、跨过它，这真是又有趣又刺激。耶。

lines.en: scene beachmasthree17
: I will not attempt to understand what you’re going through, but I’m certain that your pain is not “never-ending.”
lines.zh: : 我不会试图去理解你正在经历什么，但我确信你的痛苦并非「永无止境」。

lines.en: : Yeah, it seems like everybody is sure of that but me.
lines.zh: : 是啊，似乎除了我之外所有人都确信这一点。

lines.en: : It’s weird. I always figured Makoto 2.0 would be more fun and outgoing and...less of a bitch.
lines.zh: : 真奇怪。我一直以为 Makoto 2.0 会更有趣、更外向，而且……不那么像个贱人。

lines.en: : But if anything, I’ve just turned into a fatalistic version of myself who struggles even caring about all of the things she used to throw herself at every single day.
lines.zh: : 但恰恰相反，我只是变成了一个宿命论版本的自己，连过去每天都会全身心投入的事情，现在都提不起劲去在乎。

lines.en: : Trauma works in mysteriously terrible ways, I’m afraid.
lines.zh: : 恐怕创伤的作用方式就是这么神秘又糟糕。

lines.en: scene beachmasthree18
: But, Makoto...you’re wrong in referring to this stage of your life as a new you.
lines.zh: : 但是，Makoto……你把人生的这个阶段称作「新的你」，这并不对。

lines.en: : We are but a sum of the experiences we have and the hardships we endure. And I’m positive that many years from now, you’ll look back on this time and accept it as something that made you {i}you.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我们不过是自身经历与所承受苦难的总和。而且我确信，很多年以后，你回望这段时光，会把它接受为成就了{i}你{/i}的那部分。

lines.en: : Thanks. I hope you’re right. I just can’t really see things like that right now, I guess.
lines.zh: : 谢了。我希望你是对的。只是我现在大概没法那样看事情。

lines.en: scene beachmasthree19
: And that’s fine. All good things take time.
lines.zh: : 那也没关系。所有美好的事物都需要时间。

lines.en: : Besides, there are plenty of people who would be happy to lend you a hand if you ever desire to reach out for one.
lines.zh: : 再说，如果你愿意伸出手，有很多人会乐意拉你一把。

lines.en: : There are three. Miku, my mom, and Sensei. And more often than not, Sensei winds up making everything worse.
lines.zh: : 有三个。Miku、我妈，还有 Sensei。而且大多数时候，Sensei 最后都会把事情弄得更糟。

lines.en: : You know he’s not trying to, though.
lines.zh: : 可你知道他不是故意的。

lines.en: : I know.
lines.zh: : 我知道。

lines.en: : Also, there’s a fourth person right beside you.
lines.zh: : 另外，你身边还有第四个。

lines.en: scene beachmasthree20
: Thanks again, but you don’t actually mean that. You’re just saying it out of pity and obligation because you feel bad for the girl with the dead dad.
lines.zh: : 再次谢谢，可你其实不是那个意思。你只是出于怜悯和义务才这么说，因为你同情那个死了爸爸的女孩。

lines.en: : That’s not true at all. In fact, I’ve always admired what you do for the class.
lines.zh: : 完全不是这样。事实上，我一直很敬佩你为班级做的事。

lines.en: : And if it weren’t for the worksheets you would make me when I first transferred in, I can’t say I’d even {i}be{/i} here right now.
lines.zh: : 而且当初我转学过来的时候，如果不是你给我做的那些练习卷，我不敢说自己现在还会{i}在{/i}这里。

lines.en: : But I’m happy I am. Which means that part of that happiness should belong to you as well.
lines.zh: : 但我很高兴我在这里。而这意味着，那份快乐里也该有你的一份。

lines.en: : You’ve not only earned it, but {i}need{/i} it more than anyone right now.
lines.zh: : 你不仅配得上它，而且现在比任何人都更{i}需要{/i}它。

lines.en: scene beachmasthree21
: That’s...
: That’s actually one of the nicest things anyone has ever said to me.
lines.zh: : 这其实是我听过的最温柔的话之一。

lines.en: : If that is true...that is very sad.
lines.zh: : 若真如此……那实在令人难过。

lines.en: : It really is, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 确实如此，不是吗？

lines.en: : Makoto...forgive me if this is too forward. Or if this is not how the process normally goes as I’m still mostly unfamiliar with it-
lines.zh: : Makoto……若我太过唐突，还请原谅。或者若这不符合通常的流程——毕竟我对它还很不熟悉——

lines.en: : But I’d very much like to be friends with you if that is something you’d have any interest in.
lines.zh: : 但我非常希望能和你做朋友，如果你对此有兴趣的话。

lines.en: scene beachmasthree22
: I’m also not that familiar with the process...but I’d like that too.
lines.zh: : 我对这个流程也不太熟悉……但我也愿意。

lines.en: : It’s a breath of fresh air talking to someone who I don’t feel like I’m {i}responsible{/i} for in some way.
lines.zh: : 能和一个我不觉得自己要为之{i}负责{/i}的人说话，真是令人耳目一新。

lines.en: : That does sound tiring, yes. And also dissuades me from burdening you with the plea for advice I was just moments away from requesting.
lines.zh: : 那听起来确实很累人，是的。而这也让我打消了原本马上就要向你求助、讨教建议的念头。

lines.en: : Is it about the present you got for Sensei? The one you told me about earlier?
lines.zh: : 是关于你给 Sensei 的礼物吗？你之前跟我说过的那个？

lines.en: : It is.
lines.zh: : 是的。

lines.en: : Seeing as you returned last year’s present to me, I was wondering if I had perhaps gone a bit...overboard as well this year.
lines.zh: : 鉴于你把我去年的礼物退回来了，我在想，今年我是不是也……有点过火了。

lines.en: : Do you want my honest answer? As a friend?
lines.zh: : 你想要我诚实的答案吗？作为朋友？

lines.en: : If you’d be so inclined.
lines.zh: : 如果你愿意说的话。

lines.en: scene beachmasthree23
: I think you’re fucking insane.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你他妈疯了。

lines.en: : Hah...that’s what I was worried about.
lines.zh: : 哈……我担心的就是这个。

lines.en: : Gift-giving truly is my weakest point, I suppose.
lines.zh: : 看来送礼确实是我最弱的一项。

lines.en: : The thought that went into it, though-
lines.zh: : 不过你花的心思——

lines.en: : I’m sure the thought is great, yeah.
lines.zh: : 我相信你花的心思很棒，对。

lines.en: : I just don’t really think you understand quite {i}what{/i} you’ve done yet.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得你还没完全明白自己到底做了{i}什么{/i}。

lines.en: : Should I maybe exchange it for something else?
lines.zh: : 那我要不要换成别的？

lines.en: : Is that even possible?
lines.zh: : 那甚至可能吗？

lines.en: : Anything is possible when you are as wealthy as I am.
lines.zh: : 当你像我一样富有的时候，一切皆有可能。

lines.en: scene beachmasthree24
: I’ll leave that up to you, then.
lines.zh: : 那我就交给你自己决定了。

lines.en: : I just...
lines.zh: : 我只是……

lines.en: : I probably wouldn’t tell anyone else about it if I were you...
lines.zh: : 如果我是你，大概不会跟别人提起这件事……
